title: EXERCISE ONLY — Anconison Helene coordination gauntlet

historicalBasis.incident: Hurricane Helene, western North Carolina, September–October 2024
historicalBasis.distinction: Geographic and disaster context is historical. Agency names, requests, locations of simulated assets, incident decisions and timing are fictional. Not operational guidance or a reconstruction of actual responders' decisions.

agencies.name: Mountain Air Support — Exercise
agencies.response: accept after delay; later share an aircraft summary

agencies.name: Piedmont UAS — Exercise
agencies.response: accept; restricted access; attempt unauthorized edit must fail

observer.membership: explicit Anconison exercise membership separate from platform administration
observer.startGate: Do not start paced scenario until observer has signed in, selected Anconison, and has incident view open.

checks: Pending approval cannot see protected room details
Approved participants see only their permitted disclosure
Declined, expired, revoked and unrelated agencies cannot read incident data
Duplicate acceptance and stale version updates are rejected
View-only agency cannot edit incident or other agencies' resources
Owner-only details never appear in a partner response
Refresh and reconnection reflect persisted state without duplicate actions
Closing incident removes live participation access and retains authorized audit history
Maintenance expiration runs without granting application-role maintenance privilege

boundedLoad.scope: authenticated AIRS reads and approved synthetic incident writes only; no Cognito password traffic or AWS map tile load test
stopOn: read p95 above 2 seconds for two samples
boundedLoad.note: Controlled baseline gauntlet, not a proof of maximum production capacity. Record latency, error counts and actual load; do not report synthetic successes.
